patch_description: The current multi-start + local search version crashes with "float division by zero" on Placement 3 (e.g., when `rem_mem[g] - m.model_size` becomes 0). The earlier simple greedy version achieved a combined score of 21.89, so I revert to that greedy but add a guard: GPUs whose remaining memory after placement would be zero (no KV cache room) are treated as infinite KVPR and skipped, preventing the division by zero while preserving the good behavior.
